The petitioner has challenged an order dated 12.12.2019 passed by the I Additional Senior Civil Judge, Kalaburagi in E.P.No.304/2013, by which, it accepted a memo of calculation filed by the decree holder/land loser.

sentences.text: 2. A proceeding under Section 18(3) of the Land Acquisition Act was initiated by the land loser in respect of land bearing Sy.No.69 of Shaikh Roza village, Kalaburagi Taluka and District.
The Land Acquisition Officer fixed the market value of the acquired land at a sum of Rs.1,25,500/- per acre.
The reference Court enhanced the market value of the land to a sum of Rs.187.50/- per sq.ft. along with other benefits as permitted.
This was NC: 2024:KHC-K:3672 challenged by the State Government in MFA No.32806/2013 and other appeals.
This Court reduced the market value to a sum of Rs.150/- per sq.ft.
Consequent to which, the decree holder filed E.P.No.304/2013.

The decree holder filed a memo of calculation which is as follows:

The Executing Court in terms of its order dated 12.12.2019, rejected the memo of calculation filed by the beneficiary and accepted the memo of calculation filed by NC: 2024:KHC-K:3672 the decree holder.
Being aggrieved by the said order, the beneficiary is before this Court in this writ petition.

6. Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the Executing Court relied upon the judgment of the Apex Court in the case of Radha Mudaliyar Vs. Special Tahsildar (Land Acquisition), Tamil The Union Of India vs Santosh Kumar And Anr on 6 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128779752/
5

entities.text: Radha Mudaliyar Vs. Special Tahsildar (Land Acquisition), Tamil The Union Of India vs Santosh Kumar And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Nadu Housing Board reported in (2010) 13 SCC 384 and held that the decree holder was entitled to interest on the aggregate amount including the solatium.

He contended that the Apex Court in paragraph No.32 held as follows:
"32. xxxxx.

In any case there can be no doubt in law that the claimants are entitled to the solatium and the interest thereupon at the rate specified in the proviso to Section 34 of the Act for the relevant period."

7. He therefore, contended that the memo of calculation was clearly in violation of rate of interest as permitted under Section 34 of the Land Acquisition Act and hence, the memo of calculation submitted by the decree holder was incorrect.

A perusal of the memo of calculation filed by the decree holder shows that there was inherent mistake, inasmuch as the solatium was awarded not on the basis of the market value determined by this Court in MFA No.32806/2013 and other connected cases, but was determined after deducting the amount paid as per the award of the Land Acquisition Officer.

In view of the judgment of the Apex Court in the case of Radha Mudaliyar supra, the rate of interest on solatium, was not to exceed the rates specified under Section 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, which also was not taken into consideration while calculating the compensation to which the decree holder was entitled.

9. In that view of the matter, both the memo of calculations filed by the decree holder as well as the beneficiary deserve to be rejected and they are liable to be directed to file fresh memo of calculations taking into account the law declared in the case of Radha Mudaliyar as well as the judgment of the Apex Court in the case of NC: 2024:KHC-K:3672 State of Punjab Vs. Amarjit Singh & Another reported in AIR 2011 SC 982.
10.

entities.text: NC: 2024:KHC-K:3672 State of Punjab Vs. Amarjit Singh & Another reported in AIR 2011 SC 982
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Hence, following:
ORDER (i) The petition is allowed.
(ii) The impugned order passed by the Executing Court is set aside and the matter is remitted back to the Executing Court directing both the beneficiary as well as the decree holder to file fresh memo of calculations in the light of the observations made above.
(iii) The Executing Court shall consider the same in accordance with law and dispose off the execution petition in accordance with law.
